methodologyNotes: Covers standalone terrestrial spotting scopes (birding, hunting, target shooting, digiscoping) sold at a published US MSRP. Excludes astronomical telescopes, binoculars, monoculars, and riflescopes. Price is typical US MSRP for the body-plus-zoom-eyepiece configuration in USD; for modular systems where the eyepiece is sold separately, price reflects body plus the standard zoom eyepiece. objectiveLensMm is the objective lens diameter in millimeters. magnificationRange is the zoom eyepiece range as published, e.g. '20-60x'. glassType is an enum describing the premium objective element: 'fluorite', 'ED' (extra-low dispersion), 'HD', or 'standard'. viewingAngle is an enum: 'angled', 'straight', or 'both' when the model is offered in both eyepiece orientations. fieldOfViewFt1000yd is the linear field of view in feet at 1000 yards, measured at the lowest magnification. closeFocusFt is the minimum/near focus distance in feet. eyeReliefMm is eye relief in millimeters at the lowest magnification. waterproof is a boolean (submersion-rated sealing). nitrogenPurged is a boolean (inert-gas fill for internal fog resistance). lengthIn is overall body length in inches. weightOz is body weight in ounces, excluding the eyepiece for modular models; null if not disclosed.
